title: TCP Send
text: Send data over TCP/IP network to remote host, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Connection mode} sets the block as server, {Server IP Address} sets the remote IP address of server to which to send data is sent, {Server IP Port} sets the remote IP port on server to which data, {Local IP Port} sets the iP port on sending host from which to send, {Enable variable length} enables to receive variable data length, {Wait until previous packet transmitted} sets the wait until data received in previous time step and {Output transmit status} sets the option to display the transmit status during data. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: Data transmitted at given time step scalar

params.name: Connection mode
params.values: Set the block as server or client Server (default) | Client

params.name: Server IP Address
params.values: Remote IP address of server to which to send data is sent 192.168.1.10 (default) | any valid IP address

params.name: Server IP Port
params.values: Remote IP port on server to which data is sent 25002 (default) | positive integer in the range [1,65535]

params.name: Local IP Port
params.values: IP port on sending host from which to send data 25000 (default) | positive integer in the range [1,65535]

params.name: Enable variable length
params.values: Enable to receive variable data length off (default) | on

params.name: Wait until previous packet transmitted
params.values: Wait until data received in previous time step is sent off (default) | on

params.name: Output transmit status
params.values: Option to display the transmit status during data transmission off (default) | on
